positions.title: Research Software Engineer
positions.description:
Currently, exploring explainability and interpretability of LLMs through different methods of measuring salience and importance.

Previously:

* Implemented a streaming multi-track active speaker detection system which attained SOTA on the AVA dataset and integrated it into a Google Nest.
* Designed an approach for fine tuning the PaLM v1 LLM to solve topic segmentation tasks.
* Imported a 5M video dataset and evaluated topic segmentation algorithms on it using my custom pk and windowdiff implementations.
* Created a harness for evaluating different diffusion models for an ads product.

positions.title: Development Manager
positions.description:
Seeing an excellent opportunity to work with an entrepreneurial and ambitious NGO focused on improving the quality, effectiveness, and impact of both international aid projects and CSR programs, I joined NEERMAN in October.  NEERMAN is a leading expert in the monitoring and evaluation field and uses its research to give decision-makers in government, corporations, NGOs an evidence-based background from which to inform its policies and programs.  We also work in program design and facilitate capacity building sessions.

Being a small outfit, my tasks are diverse but the most significant include:

• Exploring and structuring partnerships for CSR program design and projects in monitoring and evaluation with clients and advisors
• Creating a new vertical within the firm in CSR consulting and impact evaluations.
• Designing and then executing a brand-new social media strategy
• Website development

positions.title: Community and Organizational Development Advisor
positions.description:
Peace Corps Moldova's Community and Organizational Development Program sent me to a village called Bacioi to consult for a NGO, and to identify and analyze development opportunities through the strategic and sustainable lens of building capacity.  This non-traditional, entrepreneurial, multi-cultural and lingual setting allowed me to pull on my strengths of a self-starter as I found and then leveraged partnerships to marshal community resources for positive social impact.  

Representative projects and programs include:

• Founding member of Active Civic Education which developed, promoted, and implemented participative curriculums and programs
• Board member for MoldovaTiP, Peace Corps Moldova’s anti- trafficking organization
• Taught a semester-long business ethics and leadership course at the Academy of Economic Studies of Moldova 
• Directed a civic education program in which 120 teenagers in twelve different communities resolved problems in their communities that they identified themselves  
• Planned and facilitated entrepreneurship seminars for high school students across the country

positions.title: Grant Writer, Environmental and Health Assistant
positions.description:
Didion hired me to complete a grant that had a deadline within two weeks.  After quickly learning the technical processes in ethanol production, I contributed to the grant writing team's successful proposal to the Department of Energy.  Afterwards, I stayed on to help with environmental and safety compliance of all of Didion's facilities spread across Wisconsin.  

Representative projects include:

• Reviewed, wrote, and prepared, technical material
• Ensured operational compliance with regulatory agencies
• Evaluated and improved the safety in milling and ethanol facilities
• Participated and contributed to brainstorming sessions to design and later win a     Department of Energy grant
• Created and applied a chemical labeling system for safety purposes
• Communicated reporting requirements to relevant employees
